facts.text: Audrey believes the dogs will catch on quickly to training.

evidence.quote: I'm sure they'll catch on really quick! They're quick learners and love rewards!

facts.text: Audrey plans to keep Andrew updated on the progress of the dogs during the training.

evidence.quote: I'll keep you updated on how it all goes and how my pups are doing.

facts.text: Audrey attended a positive reinforcement training class at a local pet store.

evidence.quote: I saw this workshop flyer at my local pet store. It was a positive reinforcement training class and I wanted to give it a shot.

facts.text: Audrey met a friendly and playful dog at the pet store, which was a volunteer's dog.

evidence.quote: The volunteer in the store was nice enough to let me meet their dog – he was so friendly and playful!
